description: This file defines the JwtAudienceInvalidException class, a custom exception used in JWT processing within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes builder methods, JSON parsing, and exception handling specific to invalid 'aud' (audience) claims in JWT tokens.

classes.name: JwtAudienceInvalidException
classes.description: Custom exception class indicating invalid 'aud' claim in JWT tokens, extends DittoRuntimeException and implements JwtException.

classes.name: JwtAudienceInvalidException.Builder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing JwtAudienceInvalidException instances with fluent API.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for JwtAudienceInvalidException, optionally with a specific 'aud' value.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a JwtAudienceInvalidException from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers.
